preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string is between 1 and 100,000.
Each string consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (0 <= output[i] <= ns[i] and output[i] % 2 == 0) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output is either -1 or an even number between 0 and the length of the corresponding string.
